mechanism: Foscarnet can cause electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) and renal impairment that may increase buspirone levels and CNS effects; both agents have potential for CNS depression.
action: Monitor for increased buspirone adverse effects (dizziness, drowsiness); assess renal function and electrolytes regularly; adjust buspirone dose if necessary based on clinical response and tolerability.
